title: Jujutsu Kaisen: Kaigyoku/Gyokusetsu
content:
Holy censorship. More on that later. So let’s glaze the hell out of this “recap” for now.

Crazy, right? Glazing a recap out of all thing, but to be honest, the quality of the og content really puts this one high on its legs. Watching the Hidden Inventory arc of jjk in movie format was almost better than experiencing it episodically in a way. You get all the fun, sadness, and action onto one singular 2 hours scoop of continuous entertainment. For that reason, I discourage everyone who wants to watch this so soon after watching season two’s first half from doing so. It’s too goodto spoil the fun while knowing all the tiny details.

In my specific case, it has been a while since I last watched any jjk content that I forgot 70% of the conflict and mis-ups of this arc that this recap movie had me gripped up and on my toes the entire time. I even appreciated the story way, waaaayy more than I first did. I feel like I finally digested the story the correct way after so long.

Thank God for the absence of voice over that commonly plagues many recap releases, it truly played like how a proper movie would, great pacing with a few rough cuts here and there, but I digres.

The only annoying production decision that hurt this release in my opinion was the unnecessary censorship during Gojo’s and Toji’s first encounter. You know exactly the scene I’m referring to. The Gore in that scene was shocking the first time and the fact that it was shown to begin with played a huge role in making a big deal out of the that matchup and how it concluded, but here they decided to run a lazy black and white filter over everything with a faint present of dimming and blurring effects to lessen the violence in the scene.

Despite the latter, this was an absolute blast for a rewatch. Perfectly compacted with no enjoyment treadoffs.

Overall: 9.04/10.
